title: carex pamirensis subsp. angustispicata
intro: Carex pamirensis subsp. angustispicata, commonly known as Pamir sedge, is a type of perennial sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which may contribute to its health benefits. Bioactive constituents of Pamir sedge include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
